The two finished posts are set on top of the left side frame (arrows).

why.problem_solved: Builds the two tall supports that the air cylinder will hang between.
why.why_these_parts: An L-beam with a 5-hole beam on its tall leg gives a post two pin holes wide, so a cylinder pivot pin can pass through.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 24 puts the cylinder between these posts.
